title_formula.example: Bean to cup coffee machine with grinder Demo Brand A300 Milk | with milk frother, 15 bar

rules: The most important phrases go in the first ~50 characters, because that is usually all Google shows in a Shopping ad.
The brand stays in the visible part of the title, but after the phrase that sells.
Every title stays within the 150-character limit.
Descriptions: main phrase first, supporting phrases once each, no promotional claims.
kp_insights: “Bean to cup coffee machine” is the biggest phrase that describes exactly this type of product.
“With grinder” is a feature customers actively search for.
The brand itself is searched regularly, so it stays in the visible part of the title.
kp_note: Volume alone is not enough: a popular phrase doesn't necessarily sell. That's why step 2 checks which phrases actually brought in sales.
themes: In the title as a feature
ads_insights: “Bean to cup” brought in the most sales of all themes, more than plain “espresso machine”, despite lower volume.
“With grinder” returned 4.5 € in sales for every euro spent.
“For home” is how customers describe the machine in their own words, so it went into the descriptions.
top_terms: bean to cup coffee machine with grinder

added: “bean to cup with grinder” and “portafilter” at the start of the title
each model's key feature at the end of the title
removed: promotional claims (“brand new”, “you'll love”) and anything not confirmed on the product page

highlight: bean to cup coffee machine with grinder

labels.ba_sub: Highlighted: phrases chosen based on steps 1 and 2. “Before” for the description is the start of the current product-page description.
